name: @playform/hook-dsh-core
description: The CORE: the pure, dependency-free, harness-free commonalities of the governance family (@playform/hook-dsh-core) — the dependency-section list, the exclusion-segment list, the suppression-line composer, the update-policy loader and the refusal guard. A NEW governance module reduces to a Config extension, a pure transform and an update engine; the core owns the shared pure mechanics and the module's ledger strings stay module-side. Usable outside the harness entirely (the PlayForm ecosystem).

scripts.prepublishOnly: Build 'Source/**/*.ts' --ESBuild Configuration/ESBuild.ts --TypeScript Configuration/TypeScript.noemit.json && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc-alias -f -p tsconfig.json
